lines.zh: 我走路的样子，学得很像人。
lines.en: I walk in a very human way.

lines.zh: 这件衣服是从别人身上拿的。
lines.en: This coat came off someone else.

lines.zh: 从雪地走进屋里，再走出来。
lines.en: Out of the snow, into the house, back out.

lines.zh: 我用两条腿，这不太容易。
lines.en: Two legs. It isn't easy.

lines.zh: 一步一步，把脚印留整齐。
lines.en: Step by step, leaving tidy prints.
I know you'll look back.
The porch light is still on. Good.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，不惊动狗。
lines.en: I follow the wall so the dogs stay quiet.
This body just learned to turn.
My footsteps sound like yours.
I circle the camp and come from behind.
I smile the whole way over.
I stand still like someone waiting.
These hands shouldn't be this quiet.
I'm deciding which face to use.

lines.zh: 衣服下面还有别的东西。
lines.en: There's something else under the coat.
I've matched the rhythm of breathing.
That room next door is empty.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在数还剩几个。
lines.en: I hear someone counting who's left.
I don't knock. I wait for the door.
The smile has gone a bit stiff.
I look down at my own hands.
When you opened the door, I was there.

lines.zh: 你看我，觉得哪里不对吧。
lines.en: You look at me and sense something wrong.
Have we met before?
I'm copying how your mouth moves.
Your companion isn't here tonight.
Don't keep your hand on that handle.
This face is borrowed.

lines.zh: 你身后是不是少了一个人？
lines.en: Isn't someone missing behind you?

lines.zh: 我看着你的时候，很专注。
lines.en: I'm very focused when I watch you.
You're doubting. That's a relief.
Tear this skin and I can change it.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方在长回来了。
lines.en: The spot you hit is growing back.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，主要是礼貌。
lines.en: I stepped back out of politeness.
You actually dared to swing.
The blood is red. Don't misunderstand.
That blow froze my smile.
The coat tore. It won't hide it now.
You'll need many more of those.
Pain? I'm learning that expression.

lines.zh: 你递东西的样子真温柔。
lines.en: The way you offer it is so gentle.

lines.zh: 我不吃，可我想碰你的手。
lines.en: I won't eat, but I want to touch your hand.
I copied your chewing twice.
Leave it on the table. I'll come over.

lines.zh: 这块肉还热，是你的手暖的。
lines.en: The meat's warm from your hands.
Feed me and we're acquainted.

lines.zh: 我闻得出你刚才碰过什么。
lines.en: I can smell what you touched before.
You open your hand; I open mine.
Won't you have a bite too?

lines.zh: 撞上我，你摸到的是别人的肩。
lines.en: Bump me and you feel someone else's shoulder.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我还不习惯这双腿。
lines.en: Sorry, I'm not used to these legs.
We're standing too close.
Don't step back; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 撞一下，你的体温我记住了。
lines.en: One bump and I have your temperature.
This coat is a bit empty.

lines.zh: 我的手臂卡在你和墙之间。
lines.en: My arm is caught between you and the wall.
A light bump, and you're the nervous one.
There's half a block between us.

lines.zh: 两具人形贴在一起，很不自然。
lines.en: Two human shapes together look unnatural.
We don't breed. We trade skins.
It upsets you, so I'm pleased.
Doesn't matter if the clothes tear.

lines.zh: 里面露出来的部分，别怕。
lines.en: Don't fear what shows underneath.
I'm practicing this motion.

lines.zh: 抱着的时候，我数着骨头。
lines.en: While holding on, I count bones.
After we part, someone is missing.
It imitates people better than I do.
Quiet; there's someone on the road.

lines.zh: 我捡起一把雪，捏成手指。
lines.en: I scoop snow and shape fingers.
Let me hold your axe for you.
I'll keep this thing.
I wrap the strip of cloth around my wrist.
When picking things up, look human.
I know this iron.

lines.zh: 塞进口袋，别让它掉出来。
lines.en: Into the pocket so it doesn't fall.

lines.zh: 你掉下的，我捡得很自然。
lines.en: You dropped it; I picked it up naturally.

lines.zh: 手里拿点东西，走路才稳。
lines.en: Holding something makes the walk steadier.
This hat fits me perfectly.

lines.zh: 你转身去拿东西，就是机会。
lines.en: You turned to fetch something. My chance.
You left the door ajar, and there you are.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是你，不是屋里的人。
lines.en: I've picked you, not the others inside.

lines.zh: 你走过雪地，我看清路线了。
lines.en: You crossed the snow; I know the route.

lines.zh: 目标是你，别的人都不算。
lines.en: The target is you. No one else counts.
The smile is gone.

lines.zh: 这具身体能跑得比你想的快。
lines.en: This body runs faster than you think.
I waited at the door three nights.

lines.zh: 你刚才问我名字，我就不装了。
lines.en: You asked my name, so I'll stop pretending.
There are only the two of us here.
Close the door first. Then we'll talk.
Your armor fits well.

lines.zh: 我记住你走进来的每一步。
lines.en: I've memorized every step you took in.

lines.zh: 灯太亮了，我有点不舒服。
lines.en: The light is too bright. It bothers me.
Finding you wasn't hard.
I'm behind the door. No rush.

lines.zh: 你搬到哪间屋，我都知道。
lines.en: Whichever room you move to, I know.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在这个走廊里很响。
lines.en: Your steps are loud in this hall.
I tried the window. Locked.

lines.zh: 你数到十的时候，我就在楼下。
lines.en: When you counted to ten, I was downstairs.
I copy your gait exactly.

lines.zh: 你把火把插在走廊上，真好。
lines.en: You placed torches down the hall. Lovely.
You're upstairs, aren't you.
I stop on the third step.

lines.zh: 这件衣服我没换，你认得。
lines.en: Same coat. You'll recognize it.
You stay silent. So do I.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在门上留下了雾。
lines.en: Your breath left fog on the door.
I'll wait for you to open it yourself.
Take the long way; the front door is taken.

lines.zh: 这个屋子里只有一处是暖的。
lines.en: Only one spot in this house is warm.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头没有别的房间。
lines.en: There's no other room at the end of this hall.
You bolted the door yourself.
I'd happily wait one more night.
Your lamp is nearly out of oil.
I can see your lamp's shadow.
I hit harder than I look.

lines.zh: 这一掌带着别人的手法。
lines.en: This strike uses someone else's technique.
Skip the shield; I'll go around it.

lines.zh: 抓住你的领子，往墙上送。
lines.en: I grab your collar and send you into the wall.
Your arm is twisted behind you.
I practiced this many times.
No shouting. I strike while smiling.

lines.zh: 血溅在这件衣服上，可惜。
lines.en: Blood on this coat. Shame.
You fell in a very natural way.
One isn't enough. Another.
I use the elbow; heavier than a fist.

lines.zh: 你看我抬手时已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time you see the arm rise, it's late.

lines.zh: 我把你从楼梯上推下去。
lines.en: I shove you down the stairs.

lines.zh: 这一击带着两具身体的力气。
lines.en: This blow carries two bodies' strength.
You back to the door. It's locked.

lines.zh: 打中时，我听见骨头错位。
lines.en: On impact I hear bone shift.
Your breathing skipped a beat.
I hold you down and press slowly.

lines.zh: 这具身体的手臂还够长。
lines.en: This body's arm is still long enough.
Standing up again won't help.
I stood up out of the snowbank.

lines.zh: 这个身体刚好撑得起衣服。
lines.en: This body just fills the coat.

lines.zh: 我不是刷出来的，是走来的。
lines.en: I wasn't spawned. I walked here.

lines.zh: 屋里的灯还亮着，我看见了。
lines.en: The light in the house is on. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我离开的时候，有人还没回来。
lines.en: When I left, someone hadn't come back.

lines.zh: 先学会走路，再学会说话。
lines.en: Learn to walk first, then to talk.

lines.zh: 这具身体的手指还僵着。
lines.en: This body's fingers are still stiff.
Someone missing from camp?

lines.zh: 从林子那边过来的路不难走。
lines.en: The path from the woods wasn't hard.

lines.zh: 我的第一句话，是学来的。
lines.en: My first sentence was learned.
You didn't hear me come in.

lines.zh: 火燎过衣服，皮跟着卷起来。
lines.en: Fire catches the coat and the skin curls with it.
Falling from the stairs folded my leg.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我这张脸浮起来了。
lines.en: Water gets in, and this face floats up.
The blast peeled this skin off.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我肩上，我笑着拔掉。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder. I pull it out smiling.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我现了原形一瞬。
lines.en: The potion's glow revealed me for a moment.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具身体在垮。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet this body weakens.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，衣服烧出洞。
lines.en: Lightning struck; the coat burned through.

lines.zh: 坠下去时，这张脸也没了。
lines.en: As I fall, this face is gone too.
